pages.text: $(li)The main line is in the first tab, $(l)Dimensional Ascension$(). It runs $(l)left to right through the center$().$(li)Quests with a $(l)crown$() at the top mark where one chapter ends and the next begins.

$(li)The $(l)Big Picture$() tab shows which chapters you have started.$(li)Click the $(l)eye icon$() (top left) to show every quest, including hidden ones.$(li)The $(l)Book of Worlds$() tab shows which dimensions are open. Bosses aren't in a fixed order; available dimensions are what gate them.

The questbook works as an in-game wiki. It has sections on chargers, energy, item transport, backpacks, flight and more. Search it first.$(br2)The pack documents its own obscure mechanics, but it assumes you know the basics of the major mods.
